description: This file defines mock log data and functions to generate and filter log entries for testing purposes in a web UI project. It includes sample log entries, categories with regex patterns, and functions to produce filtered log responses based on request parameters.

methods.name: generateLogEntries
methods.description: Creates an array of sample log entries with various hosts, timestamps, programs, severity levels, raw log lines, messages, and modules.

methods.name: generateMockLogs
methods.description: Generates a filtered LogResponse object based on optional request parameters such as limit, categories, and contains keyword; filters the predefined log entries accordingly.
